topics.name: Structuring your speech
topics.summary: Taqdimot yoki og'zaki imtihonda gapingizni boshlash va bir fikrdan ikkinchisiga o'tish uchun.

usage.text: I'd like to start by saying / looking at ... — «...dan boshlamoqchiman». «by» dan keyin V-ing.

example.en: I'd like to start by saying that sport is important.

usage.text: First of all, we need to decide / examine / look at ... — «Avvalo, ...ni ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak».

example.en: First of all, we need to look at the costs.

usage.text: I'll begin with ... — «...dan boshlayman». Keyin ot.

example.en: I'll begin with a short story.

usage.text: Now I'd like to move on to ... — «Endi ...ga o'tmoqchiman».

example.en: Now I'd like to move on to the second problem.

usage.text: This leads to my next point. — «Bu meni keyingi fikrga olib keladi».

example.en: Students are tired. This leads to my next point: sleep.
example.uz: O'quvchilar charchagan. Bu keyingi fikrimga olib keladi: uyqu.

usage.text: Now let's look at / move on to (the question of ...) — «Endi ...ni ko'rib chiqaylik».

example.en: Now let's look at the question of money.

structure.formula: I'd like to start by + V-ing

example.en: I'd like to start by looking at the facts.

structure.formula: Now I'd like to move on to + ot

example.en: Now I'd like to move on to my last point.
I'll begin with the history.

topics.tip: «I'd like to start by say» — xato: «by» dan keyin har doim -ing (by saying, by looking).

topics.name: Ordering points or opinions
topics.summary: Bir nechta fikrni ketma-ket aytish: First, ... Second, ... Finally, ...

usage.text: First, ... — «Birinchidan». Second, ... — «Ikkinchidan». Finally, ... — «Nihoyat / Oxirida». Har biridan keyin vergul.

example.en: First, it's cheap. Second, it's fast. Finally, it's safe.
example.uz: Birinchidan, arzon. Ikkinchidan, tez. Nihoyat, xavfsiz.

example.en: First, I'll talk about the problem. Finally, I'll give a solution.
example.uz: Avval muammo haqida, oxirida yechim haqida gapiraman.

topics.tip: «Finally» — oxirgi fikr uchun. «At last» esa «uzoq kutilgandan keyin» degani, ro'yxat uchun emas.

topics.name: Justifying your opinions
topics.summary: Fikr aytgandan keyin uning sababini tushuntirish uchun.

usage.text: There are a number of reasons why I believe this. First, ... — «Bunga ishonishimning bir necha sababi bor».

example.en: There are a number of reasons why I believe this. First, it's healthy.
example.uz: Bunga ishonishimning bir necha sababi bor. Birinchidan, foydali.

usage.text: I'll tell you why I think that. — «Nega shunday o'ylashimni aytaman».

example.en: Music should be free. I'll tell you why I think that.
example.uz: Musiqa bepul bo'lishi kerak. Nega shunday o'ylashimni aytaman.

usage.text: The reason I say that is ... — «Buni aytishimning sababi — ...».

example.en: The reason I say that is that many children can't pay.
example.uz: Buni aytishimning sababi — ko'p bolalar to'lay olmaydi.

usage.text: The main reason I feel this way is ... — «Shunday fikrda bo'lishimning asosiy sababi — ...».

example.en: The main reason I feel this way is my own experience.

structure.formula: The reason I say that is (that) + gap

example.en: The reason I say that is that it's expensive.

structure.formula: The main reason I feel this way is + ot / that + gap

example.en: The main reason I feel this way is safety.

topics.tip: «The reason is because ...» emas — kitobdagi to'g'ri shakl: «The reason I say that is (that) ...».

topics.name: Summing up your opinion
topics.summary: Nutq oxirida asosiy fikrlarni jamlash uchun.

usage.text: To sum up, ... / In conclusion, ... / All in all, ... — «Xulosa qilib aytganda / Yakunida / Umuman olganda». Gap boshida, keyin vergul.

example.en: In conclusion, schools need more music lessons.
example.uz: Xulosa qilib aytganda, maktablarga ko'proq musiqa darsi kerak.

usage.text: Just to summarise the main points ... — «Asosiy fikrlarni qisqacha jamlasam ...».

example.en: Just to summarise the main points: it's cheap, quick and safe.
example.uz: Asosiy fikrlarni jamlasam: arzon, tez va xavfsiz.

structure.formula: To sum up, / In conclusion, / All in all, + gap

example.en: All in all, it was a great year.

topics.tip: «In conclusion» faqat oxirida ishlatiladi — nutq boshida emas.

mistakes.wrong: I'd like to start by say ...
mistakes.right: I'd like to start by saying ...

mistakes.wrong: Now I'd like to move on the next point.
mistakes.right: Now I'd like to move on to the next point.
The reason I say that is (that) ...
mistakes.why: «reason» va «because» bir xil ma'no — birga ishlatilmaydi.
